column1: # The bots' data files a release puts in the data volume of the server (lib.sh,
# "The bots' data files"; release/bot-data): what was benched, by its sha256.
# The files are private and stay out of git; $SKHID_BOT_DATA (release.env) is a
# folder laid out as the volume, and the release stops when a file is missing
# or another. Tabs between the columns; `#` starts a comment:
#   <path under the volume's data folder>  <sha256>  <size>  [<name in $SKHID_BOT_DATA>]
# The fourth column is only for a benched file that is called otherwise there.
# The maps the lobby offers (lobby-server v026g/pvb.rs MAPS: the day map of
# all 8 levels in batteries (mode 2) and in team deathmatch (mode 4), the
# files the benches read), the routes table every bench read (routes-3d.json,
# the 3D table: play 17, Cut, Crossfire, the K1 spots; on main srp reads a
# routes table only when SRP_BOT_ROUTES names it (driven.rs): it has no default
# file and takes format 1 only, routes-3d.json is format 2, so the file is put
# in the volume now and read once the bots' tiers branch lands (its default file
# <MAPDATA>/bot-routes.json, formats 1 and 2); the 16 .mapdata files take effect
# at once), and later the foliage (#544: mapdata/bot-foliage.json). Add a file with
# and commit the list with the change that was benched.
